'If there are TWO OR MORE cards with cost 3 or more in your pitch zone, this gets +4{p}.'

Both numbers are gates and both are easy to lose: `cost_gte` is the 'cost 3 or more' half and `count_gte` is the 'two or more' half. With count_gte omitted it defaults to one and the card pumps off a single expensive pitch -- strictly stronger than printed, and invisible unless a test pitches exactly one.
